connectivity.title: Connection check
connectivity.about_page: The kit has to know which features are available while the connection is missing or a VPN is down, and not to cycle model providers blindly. This section describes the connection: profiles (names of channels), check addresses and rules. While the check is off, the kit works as before.
connectivity.scope: Applies to every project on this machine. Stored in the kit, never goes to git. File:
connectivity.enable_hint: Off — the kit works as before: nothing is checked and nothing is blocked. On — before a run the kit checks that what it needs is available and does not cycle providers blindly.
connectivity.mode.off: The check is off — the kit works as before.
connectivity.mode.offline: Mode of work — offline, only features that need no connection are available.
connectivity.mode.down: {names} is down; features that do not need {names} and web features are available.|{names} are down; features that do not need them and web features are available.
connectivity.global.online: The connection is fine: everything needed is available.
connectivity.global.degraded: Everything needed is available, but some check addresses do not answer.
connectivity.global.partial: Some dependencies are unavailable: features that do not need them work.
connectivity.global.no_vpn: The internet is up, but the VPN profiles needed are down.
connectivity.global.offline: No internet: only features that need no connection are available.
connectivity.global.unknown: State unknown: not checked yet, or the data is out of date.
connectivity.reason.provider_vpn: Provider {name} is unavailable: {profile} does not answer
connectivity.check_save_first: Save the changes first: the saved setup is what gets checked. An address that is not saved yet is checked with the «Check» button next to it.
connectivity.empty_title: No profiles yet — where to start
connectivity.probe_what: A probe is an address that answers only when the connection is there (for example, an internal service behind a VPN, or any site to check the internet). From time to time the kit asks it and judges from the answer whether the channel is alive.
connectivity.empty_how: A profile is the name of a channel, for example VPN-1; it has one or more probes. Sources and model providers then refer to the profile by name, and the project holds no addresses at all. Start with the first profile — it takes three steps.
connectivity.wiz1: 1. Name the profile, for example VPN-1. The name is for you to recognise it; sources and providers refer to it later.
connectivity.wiz1_net: 1. The internet is a built-in profile. The kit knows no third-party addresses and never goes anywhere on its own: enter any address you trust (for example, example.com). While there are no addresses, the internet is «unknown» — which is not «no internet», and nothing is blocked.
connectivity.wiz2: 2. Enter an address that answers only while the VPN is on, choose the type of check and, for TCP, the port.
connectivity.wiz2_net: 2. Enter an address that answers whenever the internet is up and choose the type of check.
connectivity.wiz3: 3. Press «Check» — we show the answer, the time and what counts as normal.
connectivity.wiz3_fail: No answer. If the VPN is off right now, that is fine: you can add the profile and check later. Otherwise check the address and the type.
connectivity.wiz_fill: Enter the address (and the port for TCP).
connectivity.h_name: Latin letters, digits, «-», «_», «.». Example: VPN-1. The name internet is taken by the kit.
connectivity.h_type.tcp: Good for «the port is open»: the kit opens a connection to the host and port. Example: example.com, port 443.
connectivity.h_type.http: Good for «the service answers»: the kit requests the address and checks the status and, if set, the text. Example: https://example.com/health.
connectivity.h_type.icmp: A plain ping. Sometimes forbidden: many servers and networks drop it — then use TCP or HTTP. Example: example.com.
connectivity.h_host.tcp: A name or IP without http:// and a path. Example: example.com.
connectivity.h_host.icmp: A name or IP. Example: example.com.
connectivity.h_url: http:// or https://, no login and password in the address. Example: https://example.com/health.
connectivity.h_status: Which answers count as normal: numbers (200) or classes (2xx). Empty — 2xx and 3xx. If a service answers 401 without a login, enter 401.
connectivity.h_body: Optional: text that must appear at the start of the answer (within the first 64 KB). Example: OK.
connectivity.h_timeout: How long to wait for this address. Empty — the common value from the settings below.
connectivity.h_interval: How often the panel checks this address. Empty — the common value.
connectivity.h_label: For you: what this address is for. Does not affect the check.
connectivity.limit_note: Limit: no more than {max} probes for the whole kit.
connectivity.no_probes: The profile has no probes — add at least one address.
connectivity.code.body: the expected text is not in the answer
connectivity.code.no_ping: no ping command in the system
connectivity.h_agg.any_healthy: The profile is available while at least one address answers: one failed service does not take the whole VPN down. Recommended.
connectivity.h_agg.quorum: The profile is available if at least K addresses of its list answer.
connectivity.h_agg.all_healthy: The profile is available only if all addresses answer. Strict: any failure counts as losing the channel.
connectivity.h_quorum: How many addresses must answer. Example: 2.
connectivity.h_fail_after: The profile counts as unavailable only after N checks in a row failed — a single blink does not count. Empty — the common value.
connectivity.h_ok_after: The profile returns to «available» after M checks in a row succeeded. Empty — the common value.
connectivity.h_note: For you; does not affect the check.
connectivity.not_required: not needed by the current work
connectivity.not_required_hint: No enabled source of the selected project and no model provider refers to this profile: it does not affect the overall state.
connectivity.profile_drop_ask: Remove profile «{name}» together with its probes ({n})?
connectivity.profiles_about: A profile is the name of a communication channel. Sources and model providers refer to it by name; the check addresses are kept here, on the machine, and never go into a project.
connectivity.internet_about: Checks the internet in general. There are no third-party addresses by default: the kit does not go to foreign addresses without your setup. Enter any address you trust (for example, example.com).
connectivity.internet_none: No addresses: the internet is «unknown» — which is not «no internet», and nothing is blocked.
connectivity.internet_wizard: Add an address to check the internet
connectivity.h_interval_all: How often the panel checks the profiles (seconds, from 10). Data older than three intervals counts as unknown.
connectivity.h_timeout_all: How long to wait for one address (1–30 s).
connectivity.h_fail_after_all: N failures in a row — and the profile is «unavailable».
connectivity.h_ok_after_all: M successes in a row — and the profile is «available» again.
connectivity.f_policy: Policy of automatic runs without a connection
connectivity.policy.partial: partial — do what is available, skip the rest
connectivity.policy.queue: queue — wait for the connection, then everything
connectivity.policy.partial_queue: partial + queue — what is available now, postpone the rest and repeat
connectivity.h_policy.fail_fast: If a run lacks a connection, it does not start and names the reason.
connectivity.h_policy.partial: Steps that lack a connection are skipped with a note; the others go on.
connectivity.h_policy.queue: The run waits until the connection is back and only then goes as a whole.
connectivity.h_policy.partial_queue: Recommended for night runs: steps that lack a connection are postponed and repeated once it is back, the rest goes at once.
connectivity.policy_note: Applies to Cron, routes and bots. A run from the panel asks you in a dialog: «run only what is available», «cancel» or «queue».
connectivity.providers_about: Binding a provider to a profile and checking its endpoint are set in the «Models» section; here is the state only.
connectivity.prov_why.profile_unknown: the profile has not been checked
connectivity.prov_why.provider_unknown: the endpoint has not been checked
connectivity.prov_why.no_profile: the profile is not in the setup
connectivity.err.bad_config: The setup could not be read
connectivity.err.bad_flag: «Check is on» is yes or no
connectivity.err.bad_settings: The common settings are filled in wrongly
connectivity.err.bad_interval: The interval is an integer from 10 to 86400 seconds
connectivity.err.bad_timeout: The answer time is an integer from 1 to 30 seconds
connectivity.err.bad_fail_after: N is an integer from 1 to 20
connectivity.err.bad_ok_after: M is an integer from 1 to 20
connectivity.err.bad_policy: Choose a policy from the list
connectivity.err.bad_profiles: The list of profiles is filled in wrongly
connectivity.err.bad_profile: The profile is filled in wrongly
connectivity.err.bad_name: A profile name is a label, not an address: Latin letters, digits, «_», «-», at most one «.»; up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or digit
connectivity.err.reserved_name: This name is taken by the kit
connectivity.err.dup_profile: A profile with this name already exists (or the name is taken by the kit)
connectivity.err.bad_internet: The internet rule is filled in wrongly
connectivity.err.bad_aggregate: Choose a rule from the list
connectivity.err.bad_quorum: K is an integer from 1 to {max}
connectivity.err.bad_probes: The list of probes is filled in wrongly
connectivity.err.bad_probe: The probe is filled in wrongly
connectivity.err.bad_probe_id: Probe identifier: a-z, 0-9, «_», «-»; up to 24 characters
connectivity.err.unknown_profile: The probe names a profile that does not exist
connectivity.err.unknown_probe: There is no such probe in the saved setup
connectivity.err.bad_host: The address is a host name or IP without http:// and spaces
connectivity.err.bad_port: The port is an integer from 1 to 65535
connectivity.err.bad_url: The address is http:// or https:// and a host, with no login and password in it
connectivity.err.bad_status: Expected statuses are numbers 100–599 or classes like 2xx; up to ten
connectivity.err.bad_body: The expected text is up to 200 characters, without control characters
connectivity.err.probe_limit: No more than {max} probes per kit
connectivity.err.conflict: The setup changed on disk since the page was opened. Your edits are still on the page: press «Discard changes» to load the fresh setup, then make them again.
connectivity.err.busy: The setup file is busy with another process — try again
connectivity.err.write: The setup could not be written
connectivity.err.not_kit: This is a project folder, not the kit
connectivity.err.tests: A test run does not write the machine's personal setup
connectivity.err.broken_file: The previous setup file cannot be read. Saving will replace it as a whole. Replace?
connectivity.reason.nothing_required: Nothing to check yet: no source or provider is bound to a profile, and the internet is not checked. Binding is set in «Project settings» and in «Models».
connectivity.reason.check_unusable: The endpoint check of provider {name} cannot be built: address, key or cleartext http
connectivity.prov_why.check_unusable: the endpoint check cannot be built (address, key or cleartext http)
connectivity.code.late: did not finish in the common time
